standard-dialogue.npc: Fascinating, fascinating. It's remarkable what these young dwarves have managed to create. Oh, hello young [man/woman/one].

standard-dialogue.player: Hello, what's a gnome like you doing in a place like this?

standard-dialogue.npc: Ah, well I have been sent by King to talk with the dwarves here and find out more about their recent advances in technology.
The rideable carts are a very handy way to get to mining sites, and the Blast Furnace is a magnificent beast of a machine.

gnome-restaurant-dialogue.text: If the player doesn't have the correct item in their inventory:

steps.text: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!

gnome-restaurant-dialogue.text: If the player has a premade item in their inventory:

steps.text: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.

gnome-restaurant-dialogue.text: If the player has the correct item in their inventory:

steps.text: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food item] to Professor Manglethorp.

steps.npc: Just what I need. Dwarven cuisine is a bit ... solid for my tastes.

steps.text: If the reward is grand seed pods:

steps.npc: Here, take these Grand Seed pods. Very useful in emergencies!

steps.text: You are given some seed pods as a tip.
If the reward is coal or gold ore:

steps.npc: Here have this, I traded for it with some of the dwarves.

steps.text: You are given some [coal/gold ore] as a tip.
If the reward is anything else:

steps.npc: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.

steps.text: You are given [a/some] [reward item(s)] as a tip.

gnome-restaurant-dialogue.text: If the player ran out of time:

steps.text: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
